$comment: Source rows for the check bundle (QC loop redesign 2026-09-24, workstreams 1 and 2). One row per requirement the observer measures: what to check, on which pages and states, against which source field, with which comparator and threshold, and how a finding becomes a ticket. tests/build-checks.mjs compiles these with the policy bundle (ticket class -> owner role and evidence profile), the field map, the lifecycle spec and the registries into spec/check-bundle.generated.json; the observer loads that bundle and the filer applies it. Thresholds, host lists, exemptions and grace periods live here and in the registries, never in the observer's config. Defaults below fill any field a row leaves out. A row's expected value is either a literal or a derivation (source id from sourceHealth, field, transform). decisionPending names the APEX ticket whose decision can change the row; the row carries the recommended value until then. Rows and retirements must together cover every name in registry/observer-checks.json. 1.1 (2026-09-24): exemptionsRef may be a string or an array of strings; the campus CTA rows read registry/campus-cta-exceptions.json (named, dated, expiring exceptions per campus and CTA) and the identity rows read registry/campus-leadership.json groups (shared leadership across sibling campuses). 1.2 (2026-09-25, decisions by Matt Barge): channel source-digest for source-versus-source comparisons that are not website defects (the map-source rows comparing the Operations sheet, the growth map API and HubSpot, and the Community record, URL form and host rows); the filer never files them and writes them to source-digest.md grouped by owner role (sourceDigest.ownerRoles). grounding {kind, ref} on every row (complaint, source-contract, exemplar, decision, none; the 2026-09-15 precedence order): the builder sets status advisory on any enforced row whose grounding is none (promotion rule, docs/observer-requirements.md). depth (render or http) per row, defaulted from pageFamily through depthDefaults; the observer renders only render rows and fetches http rows over HTTP. 1.3 (2026-09-25, decision by Matt Barge: check from HubSpot to the website, not only from the website to HubSpot): entitySource per row (hubspot-programs or map; campus rows default to hubspot-programs through entitySources.<id>.pageFamilies, so the observer enumerates the campuses from HubSpot Programs whose type is public and whose website is on a public host, takes the lifecycle state from type, and fetches the page at website; the map is downstream). expected.derive.onMissing (finding or skip, default skip): on finding, an in-scope entity with no registry entry is a finding of the same row with missingExpectation true, titled "no approved <thing> recorded for <state> campus <name>", filed Missing Info to the registry owner role with literals.missingAsk. literals per row carry the fixed values the observer and the filer read (missingAsk, missingThing, launchWords, assetPatterns, registries); the builder publishes them at row.literals and mirrors them at expected.literal next to expected.derive, which is where the observer reads them (rules.literalValue). aliases.pageCheck maps every tests/page-check.mjs check id to its row id (aliases.pageCheckUnmapped names the rest with the reason); agent/file-found-ticket.mjs writes customFields.requirementId from it. Comparator types are enumerated in spec/observer-comparators.json and the builder refuses any other. New coverage rows: site.coverage.open-campus-registries, site.coverage.program-page, site.coverage.open-campus-rendered. dedupeScope campus-registry (one ticket per campus and registry).

defaults.$comment: Defaults fill any field a row leaves out. clearAfterRuns counts full observer runs: 2 means two consecutive full runs, about one day at the 06:00 and 21:00 UTC cadence (docs/sweep-runbook.md, Cadence, breadth and depth). entitySource map is the default for rows that are not about campus pages; entitySources.hubspot-programs.pageFamilies lists the families whose rows default to hubspot-programs.

pageFamilies.$comment: Row pageFamily values. Real families come from spec/page-family-requirements.json; the pseudo-families below group them for rows that run on more than one.
pageFamilies.map-source: growth map API records (the HubSpot Programs mirror) and Operations sheet rows; not a page
pageFamilies.$depthNote: Depth per family (depthDefaults): campus pages, the homepage, Locations and the events pages, and the pseudo-families that group them (campus, map-routes, critical-routes), are rendered in a browser on desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844; the long tail (site: every public route) and the non-page map-source family are read over HTTP only. A row may set depth itself; a row with viewports, a browser dependency or a rendered comparator must be render.

entitySources.$comment: Where the observer takes the list of entities a row runs over (1.3, decision 2026-09-25 Matt Barge: check from HubSpot to the website, not only from the website to HubSpot). hubspot-programs: enumerate HubSpot Programs whose type is one of publicTypes and whose website host is one of publicHosts; lifecycle state is the Program type; the page is fetched at website with the trailing slash normalised; fields lists every Program property the observer needs for these rows. map: the growth map API records (the HubSpot mirror), downstream of HubSpot; used by rows that measure the map itself and by non-campus rows. Rows whose pageFamily is in a source's pageFamilies default to that source; a row may set entitySource itself.

hubspot-programs.pageNormalization: https, host lower-cased, trailing slash added, no query or hash
hubspot-programs.note: A Program with a public type and a public website that has no page, no registry rows or no render is a finding (the coverage rows); the observer never learns a campus only from the map or the page list.

map.note: Downstream of HubSpot Programs (docs/decisions.md 2026-09-15); rows about the map compare it with HubSpot, never the other way round.

aliases.$comment: One id everywhere (QC loop repair plan 2026-09-25, repair 7). pageCheck maps every tests/page-check.mjs check id that measures a row to that row id (a list when one page-check id spans several rows: the found-ticket filer writes the first as requirementId and all of them as requirementIds); pageCheckUnmapped names every remaining page-check id with why no row measures it. tests/build-checks.mjs extracts the ids from tests/page-check.mjs and fails when one is in neither list. agent/file-found-ticket.mjs writes customFields.requirementId from pageCheck and keeps checkId; ticket classes match on matchRequirementIds and matchCheckIds before title patterns.

pageCheckUnmapped.edge-cache-current: compares the cached and fresh copies of one page after an edit; a ring-2 verification step, not a standing requirement
pageCheckUnmapped.header-template-present: site.header.rendered has no observer row yet (spec/observer-check-map.json requirementsWithoutObserverCoverage); the route-reachable row measures the rendered 2xx, not the template
pageCheckUnmapped.header-stylesheet-linked: same as header-template-present: a shared-template requirement without an observer row
pageCheckUnmapped.h1-present: weaker than campus.hero.identity.heading (which also requires the campus name); h1-names-campus is the mapped id
pageCheckUnmapped.cta-stay-in-the-know: label presence of a template CTA; no row measures CTA labels (spec/campus-page-requirements.json campus.hero.ctas exemplars only)
pageCheckUnmapped.cta-apply-now: same as cta-stay-in-the-know; the apply rows measure the destination, not the label
pageCheckUnmapped.n8n-synced-elements-present: site.sync.n8n-synced-elements-present is listed in spec/observer-check-map.json requirementsWithoutObserverCoverage (docs/observer-requirements.md item 6)
pageCheckUnmapped.n8n-override-recorded: a ticket-protocol bookkeeping check (an override suffix must have its APEX ticket recorded); not an observer requirement
pageCheckUnmapped.team-photo-framing: team-card framing (decision 2026-09-22) is filed as observer-layout for the elementor-owner (tests/fixtures/decisions/agent-found-team-photo-framing.json); the nearest row, site.layout.images.crop (campus-image-crop-risk, coverage of visible images), belongs to observer-media-identity, so mapping it would change the class; a framing row is still to be written

depthDefaults.$comment: Row depth defaults by pageFamily (2026-09-25): render means the observer loads the page in a browser on both viewports and screenshots it; http means one HTTP fetch of the route (or a source read for map-source) with no rendering. The builder fills depth on every row that leaves it out; spec/README.md documents the contract the observer reads.

sourceDigest.$comment: Rows with channel source-digest (2026-09-25): a source-versus-source comparison whose fix is in the Operations sheet, HubSpot Programs, the growth map API or the Community app, never a WordPress element. The filer never files them; it writes source-digest.md next to its report, grouped by these owner roles, one audit line per finding. Open tickets already filed on such a row are left alone. tests/build-checks.mjs refuses a source-digest row that names a WordPress element or whose class fixes through the wordpress-alpha-mcp path.

sourceHealth.$comment: Source ids a row may depend on. providerEntity is the entity name the observer's provider-health finding carries; registryKey is the registry/sources.json entry. A finding whose row depends on a source that is failed, degraded, disabled or stale is suppressed and counted, never filed.

browser.note: a degraded browser session is reported by the loop-health rows below (route inspection, embed inspection, map inspection, every image failed)

literals.missingAsk: Add the registry entry named in this ticket for the campus; the ask per registry is in literals.registries.

registries.ask: Record the approved open-state intro media for this Open campus in registry/campus-open-media.json campuses.<slug> (openMedia card with the attachmentId of the Open and Enrolling card, or openMedia video once approved); a campus with no row cannot be measured for launch-era media.

Record the campus leadership shown on the page Team section in registry/campus-leadership.json campuses.<slug> (head-of-schools, dean-of-parents, director-of-admissions, head-guide, lead-guide, from the Admissions Hub and the live page) so the identity and roster rows can read it.
Record the campus's info packets and calendars in registry/campus-packets.json campuses.<slug> (label, url, host, hidden, schoolYear, approved) so the packet rows have an expectation.
Informational: a campus with no CTA exception entry follows the default CTA rows; nothing to add unless a decision exists.

literals.registriesNote: One finding per campus per registry whose requiredWhen.type includes the Program type and whose file has no entry at keyPath for the campus slug; the observer's finding carries missingExpectation true, registry (the registry name from the file), expected {file, keyPath}, observed (the value read), ownerRole (the entry's) and the entry's ask as its summary; the filer files it Missing Info to the entry's ownerRole (person from roleOwners) with the entry's ask and ticketClass, deduped on campus and registry. requiredWhen.type empty means informational: listed in the report, never filed.

comparator.note: One finding per campus per registry entry missing at keyPath for a registry whose requiredWhen.type includes the campus type (literals.registries); the observer emits each with missingExpectation true, registry (the registry name), expected {file, keyPath}, ownerRole and the entry ask.

rows.note: Repair 4 of docs/qc-loop-repair-plan-2026-09-25.md: on 2026-09-25 twelve Open alpha.school campuses (Austin, Brownsville, Charlotte, Chantilly, East Bay, Fort Worth, New York, Orange County, Palm Beach, San Francisco, Scottsdale, The Woodlands) had no open-media row and were never measured. The row's ticketClass and ownerRole are the open-media defaults; each registry entry overrides them.

derive.transform: for every Program whose type is Open or Announced and whose website is on alpha.school: the page at website answers HTTP 200 after redirects, its title or H1 names the campus (display_name without the School keyword, or a registry name), and the growth map lists a record with that url

literals.missingPage: critical: no page, or a page that does not name the campus, is a finding on this row (ticketClass page-status)
literals.missingFromMap: a page that answers and names the campus but has no growth-map record is not a page defect: the observer emits it with actual.missingFromMap true (or under the existing hubspot-map-sync check) and the filer writes it as a source-digest line under site.map.integrity.hubspot-map-sync for the growth-map-owner

rows.note: Source-first enumeration (repair 4): the existing site.map.integrity.wordpress-page-has-program row walks from the page list to the map; this row walks from HubSpot Programs to the page and the map, so a Program that was never published, or whose website points at a page about another campus, is found from the source.

retired.reason: Describes the legacy preferred_campus parameter and detects only the misspelled preferref_campus; the Community URL contract is campus=<verified slug> (spec/community-routing.json urlContract). The destination row compares the whole URL.

A campus video is not required: campus.intro.media accepts the approved Open and Enrolling card or an approved video (registry/campus-open-media.json). The observer config already had requireOpenCampusYouTube false, so the check was inert.
Observer-internal bookkeeping (is there an approved visual baseline); no playbook requirement. Excluded from dispatch in the observer config since the start.
Observer-internal bookkeeping (are baseline screenshots present); no playbook requirement. Excluded from dispatch in the observer config since the start.

A pixel diff against an observer-held screenshot baseline (visualDiffThreshold 0.02) is not a playbook requirement; the layout rows cover the viewport rules and page-check brand-visual covers the visual brand.
Checks that the observer's own claims configuration exists; not a site requirement. The claim rows (site.claims.evidence.*) stay advisory until the claim registry is created.

'At most N primary CTAs' is an observer page policy, not a playbook requirement: campus.hero.ctas fixes the CTA row at four (page-check cta-*). Excluded from dispatch in the observer config since the start.
An audience heuristic from the observer's page policies (does a CTA lead to a prospective-family destination) with no playbook requirement behind it.
